name: Custom Webhosting Panel
author: ArixByte
description: A custom Pterodactyl egg for webhosting panel deployments. Includes startup variables for custom webroot, PHP version, and panel services.

variables.name: Start Command
variables.description: Custom startup command for the webhosting panel.

variables.name: Web Root
variables.description: The document root for your hosted website.

variables.name: PHP Version
variables.description: PHP version for the hosted website environment.

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: Port used by the internal HTTP server.

variables.name: Domain or Panel Host
variables.description: Panel domain or hostname used by the webhosting panel.
